title: AI Research Engineer
description:
AI Research Engineer

London | £140,000-150,000 + Equity

This is a rare opportunity to join an AI-first business where machine learning is central to the product, not an add-on. You'll work on challenging real-world problems involving multimodal data, build production-grade AI systems, and play a key role in shaping the company's AI strategy.

The Company

They are a fast-growing finance business applying advanced AI and machine learning to solve complex challenges within a highly regulated environment. Backed by strong customer demand and continued growth, they are building proprietary AI capabilities that sit at the heart of their product offering. Their team combines expertise across AI, engineering, product, and data science, creating an environment where experimentation, ownership, and innovation are highly valued.

The Role

  • Train, fine-tune, and optimise large language models, embedding models, and deep learning systems.
  • Build agentic AI workflows, retrieval systems, evaluation frameworks, and AI-powered tooling.
  • Develop scalable machine learning pipelines designed for production environments.
  • Collaborate with product and engineering teams to solve complex business challenges using AI.
  • Drive experimentation, measure model performance, and identify opportunities for continual improvement.

Your Skills & Experience

  • Strong commercial experience training and deploying machine learning or deep learning models.
  • Hands-on experience with LLMs, embeddings, RAG systems, or agentic AI architectures.
  • PhD in a STEM subject.
  • Experience taking AI solutions from research or prototype stage into production.
  • Comfortable working in fast-paced environments with ambiguity, ownership, and evolving priorities.

How to Apply

If you're interested in building cutting-edge AI solutions within a high-growth environment, please get in touch with Harnham to learn more and apply.
